typescript.description: Node 24 and TypeScript: starts in a second, about 60 MB of memory.

kotlin.description: Kotlin on Micronaut, Java 25 (a trimmed runtime, about 150 MB image): about 10 s to start, about 200 MB of memory.

web-app.title: Web app
web-app.text: A site people use in a browser: a Vite+ page at / and its own API under /api. Its data belongs in an API it calls; its own SQLite keeps what only it uses.

api.title: API
api.text: Data and operations other apps call; private: browsers reach it through a web app.

worker.title: Worker
worker.text: Reacts to events, or works in a steady loop; no web address.
